title: Teenage Alberino finds the Book of Enoch at Borders

tellings.quote: I drove to a Borders bookstore and I remember I was perusing

plain: As a teenager, Tim Alberino says, he drove to a Borders bookstore, was browsing the shelves, and came across the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text that was left out of the Bible, in the 1917 English translation by R. H. Charles, shelved among the Pseudepigrapha, old writings credited to biblical figures. Alberino, who tells Michels about a 12-foot giant he says was captured in Afghanistan, describes this from his own memory as the moment his interest in these old texts began.
